propositions: Establish an immutable, non-secret OperationSnapshot type that captures validated effective configuration values, provenance by source kind, repository root, and envelope version with deterministic canonical serialization and content hashing.

Implement a central composer that enforces explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default precedence, independently selects repo_root from explicit value > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level, and delegates to existing resolve_with_sources(), repo_root(), and canonical serialization utilities.

Thread the shadow-mode snapshot through CLI, Python library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points without controlling execution; malformed config fails fast with typed error before lock/network/write, while other assembly/fingerprint/diagnostic failures emit redacted warnings and preserve authoritative legacy behavior.

Ensure snapshot fields, serialization, fingerprint, repr, equality, hashing, provenance, logs, and schemas contain no live auth objects, secret wrappers, provider clients, source paths, or subprocess environments.
REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW is enabled by default and when disabled restores legacy behavior without changing stored formats; the switch is removed in S7.

Representative ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler produce identical snapshot values, source kinds, root, version, and fingerprint; mutations after capture leave current snapshot stable while new operations observe changes.
